description: This file defines an abstract base class for policy-related events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides common properties and methods for serializing event data to JSON and managing event metadata.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing a base event related to policies, providing common fields such as type, policy ID, revision, timestamp, and headers, along with JSON serialization.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getPolicyEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with the event.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the policy.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the event, if present.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata related to the event, currently empty.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns headers related to the Ditto command that caused this event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the event type as the manifest string.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event object into a JSON representation using the specified schema version and predicate.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Abstract method to add event-specific payload data to JSON output.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this event is equal to another object.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality check, to ensure correct behavior in inheritance.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the event object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event object.
